## What changed

Describe the user-visible outcome and why it belongs in Hronaut.

> Code contributions are temporarily paused until Hronaut publishes a contributor agreement. See `CONTRIBUTING.md`. Maintainer-authored pull requests may continue to use this template.

## Validation

- [ ] I added or updated relevant automated tests.
- [ ] `npm test` passes.
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes.
- [ ] I ran the Docker integration suite when the change affects Electron, browser, MCP, clipboard, or native behavior.
- [ ] I added an `Unreleased` changelog bullet for a user-facing change, or this change does not need one.

## Security and compatibility

Note any effect on stored profiles, MCP contracts, permissions, privacy boundaries, updates, or supported platforms. Write `None` when there is no effect.
